reason: Selected teacher ablation shows capability-dependent effects of distilling explicit experience; related consolidation results require separate setting checks.

candidates.title: Test teacher capacity and state conditioning together
candidates.rule: When distilling an evolved textual skill state into model weights, compare teacher sizes both with and without that state rather than assuming a larger teacher or added guidance helps independently.
candidates.passage: The 4B teacher does not show the same benefit from state conditioning.
candidates.finding: For the fixed student and SearchQA schedule, the 27B teacher improves state-free student accuracy only with updated-state conditioning (61.21% versus 56.29% without); the 4B teacher declines with conditioning (57.57% versus 59.79%).
models: 4B and 27B teachers as specified in inspected ablation
candidates.conditions: Student initialization, selected examples, optimization schedule and evaluation split are fixed in the teacher comparison.
candidates.limitations: Repeated runs are explicitly needed to establish statistical reliability. Other tables report different full-loop SearchQA scores without enough inspected detail to combine them. The 01+11 experience selection equals updated-state successes, so it does not independently prove a benefit from transition labels.
candidates.validation_test: Run the factorial teacher-size and state-conditioning comparison across seeds, at measured distillation spend; evaluate student without guidance on new tasks and track retention of previously correct behavior.

review_scope: Selected abstract, introduction, methods or main-result sections; not a comprehensive paper or appendix review.
